from datetime import datetime

# Ensure Simple Note access token
if 'simple_note_access' not in globals() or not simple_note_access:
    creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
    sn_pw = next(item['password'] for item in creds if item['account_name']=='simple_note')
    simple_note_access = apis.simple_note.login(username='kyl_moor@gmail.com', password=sn_pw)['access_token']

# Find the "Weekly Workout Plan" note
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_candidates = []
while True:
    res = apis.simple_note.search_notes(
        access_token=simple_note_access,
        query='Weekly Workout Plan',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit,
        sort_by='-updated_at'
    )
    if not res:
        break
    all_candidates.extend(res)
    page_index += 1

print('workout_plan_candidates_count', len(all_candidates))
# Prefer exact title matches
exact = [n for n in all_candidates if n.get('title') == 'Weekly Workout Plan']
print('exact_title_count', len(exact))
# Sort by updated_at desc then created_at desc (strings ISO)
import operator

def sort_key(n):
    return (n.get('updated_at') or '', n.get('created_at') or '')

if exact:
    exact_sorted = sorted(exact, key=sort_key, reverse=True)
    selected = exact_sorted[0]
else:
    selected = sorted(all_candidates, key=sort_key, reverse=True)[0]

print('selected_note_id', selected['note_id'], 'title', selected.get('title'), 'updated_at', selected.get('updated_at'))

note_details = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=selected['note_id'], access_token=simple_note_access)
content = note_details['content']
print('note_content_length', len(content))
print('note_content_preview', content[:200].replace('\n','\\n'))

print(apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name='file_system', api_name='login'))

# Login to file_system
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
fs_pw = next(item['password'] for item in creds if item['account_name']=='file_system')
file_system_access_token = apis.file_system.login(username='kyl_moor@gmail.com', password=fs_pw)['access_token']
print('file_system_access_token_set', bool(file_system_access_token))

# Get workout plan content (from existing note_details if present)
if 'note_details' not in globals():
    # re-fetch minimal note content if needed
    sn_pw = next(item['password'] for item in creds if item['account_name']=='simple_note')
    simple_note_access_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='kyl_moor@gmail.com', password=sn_pw)['access_token']
    note_details = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=1515, access_token=simple_note_access_token)
content = note_details['content']

# Choose export path
export_path_rel = '~/workout_plan_chad.txt'

exists_resp = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=export_path_rel, access_token=file_system_access_token)
file_already_exists = bool(exists_resp.get('exists'))
print('file_exists_before', file_already_exists, 'resp', exists_resp)

if file_already_exists:
    up = apis.file_system.update_file(file_path=export_path_rel, content=content, access_token=file_system_access_token)
    print('update_file_resp', up)
    exported_file_path = up.get('file_path', export_path_rel)
else:
    cr = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=export_path_rel, access_token=file_system_access_token, content=content)
    print('create_file_resp', cr)
    exported_file_path = cr.get('file_path', export_path_rel)

print('exported_file_path', exported_file_path)

# Attach exported workout plan file to the Chad reply draft
attachment_file_paths = [exported_file_path]
print('draft_id_to_attach', 518)
print('attachment_file_paths', attachment_file_paths)

upload_resp = apis.gmail.upload_attachments_to_draft(
    draft_id=518,
    attachment_file_paths=attachment_file_paths,
    file_system_access_token=file_system_access_token,
    access_token=gmail_token
)
print('upload_resp', upload_resp)

# Send the email from draft 518
send_resp = apis.gmail.send_email_from_draft(draft_id=518, access_token=gmail_token, file_system_access_token=file_system_access_token)
print('send_resp', send_resp)

# Verification: check exported file exists
file_exists_check = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=exported_file_path, access_token=file_system_access_token)
print('file_exists_check', file_exists_check)
